notes.title: Dev Update: Smoother Skies Ahead!
notes.notes:
Hey Skybenders!

We’ve been listening closely to your feedback — and we hear you loud and clear! Our team is currently hard at work fine-tuning the onboarding experience for Dominate the Skies. 

We want every new pilot to feel confident, capable, and combat-ready from the moment they strap in. That means:

✅ Streamlined tutorials.
✅ Clearer HUD!
✅ More intuitive mission progression.
✅ A smoother learning curve for both flight and combat mechanics.

Whether you’re a rookie getting into your first anti-gravity dogfight or a seasoned ace returning for another round, the upcoming updates will help you take off faster and fly smarter.

Stay tuned for more details soon — and as always, thanks for being part of this growing community.

Now go out there and Dominate the Skies!
 — Team DTS
